summary: This is a routine Form 6-K by KE Holdings Inc., a foreign private issuer, furnishing Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong listing rules. The exhibits disclose ongoing share repurchases conducted on the HKEX and NYSE between May and August 2026, with per-share prices in HKD and USD. No new special-situation event is announced; the filing merely reports periodic buyback activity and share count changes. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation. The disclosure is standard compliance for issuers with listed shares, and no board recommendation or advisors are mentioned. The filing is best classified as routine, not a special situation.
